source: Hand-pinned deterministic fixture. Swift FixtureExporter does NOT yet emit this file because the OpenPassport native prover ships randomness internally (Barretenberg fresh-k per proof), so byte-exact proof bytes can't be pinned across the boundary. This fixture pins everything that IS deterministic: the MRZ input, the derived MRZ digest, the public signals (is_human / age_over_18 / nationality), and the field-ordering contract on the proof envelope JSON (alphabetically sorted keys, matches Swift JSONEncoder(sortedKeys)). Re-run `xcodebuild test -only-testing solidarityTests/FixtureExporter` then drop the JSON here. Swift reference: MoproProofService.buildDisclosureWitness + buildOpenPassportPayload.
